name: Gym, fitness, yoga or dance studio
description: A gym, fitness, yoga, pilates, martial arts or dance studio: the class timetable with repeating classes, memberships and passes, the instructors and members' questions, with facts about a trial class, booking, what to bring, facilities and age limits.

questions.question: Can newcomers try a class first? Is it free?
questions.help: For example "first class free, book it in advance" or "trial class 8 EUR". Leave it empty if you do not offer one.

questions.question: How do people book a place in a class?
questions.help: For example "register at the class on this site, places are limited" or "no booking needed, come 10 minutes early".

questions.question: Do you use an outside booking app or system? Give its address.
questions.help: Leave it empty if people register for classes on this site or need no booking.

questions.question: What should people bring to their first class?
questions.help: For example "comfortable clothes, indoor shoes, a towel and water; mats are provided".

questions.question: Do you have changing rooms, showers and lockers?
Are there age limits for your classes or the gym?
questions.help: For example "gym from 15 with a parent's consent, kids' classes from 6". Leave it empty if there are none.

questions.question: Since which year has the studio been open?

audit.message: Add your class timetable – each regular class once, repeating every week.
Add your memberships and passes with prices – people compare studios by them.
The memberships have not changed for a year – check the prices and what they include.
Introduce your instructors – people choose a class by who teaches it.
Say whether newcomers can try a class – it is the easiest first step.
Add your opening hours in Business details.

claude: People choose a studio by the timetable, the prices and how easy the first visit is – put the timetable, the memberships and the trial class on the home page. Each regular class is ONE item of the events collection with Repeats weekly and Repeats until; with Capacity the registration closes when the class is full. Memberships and passes are the plans collection, instructors the team. Write with energy but without pressure or body shaming. Never promise weight loss, health or medical benefits or results in a set time, and never give medical or nutrition advice – suggest asking a doctor where health matters. Never invent instructors, certifications, prices, member numbers, transformations or reviews; before-and-after photos only real and with consent.
